title: Battle of Martkopi
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Martkopi", at revision 1370449181, opens: "The Battle of Martkopi was a 1625 military confrontation between the Georgian Kingdoms of Kartli and Kakheti and Safavid Iran. The Georgians, led by general Giorgi Saakadze, annihilated an Iranian detachment of Shah-Abbas I." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871687, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1625 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
